I'm a G6 at the Doha branch and I'm buying a flat to live in. What is the largest company housing loan I can get?
The largest company housing loan you can get is QAR 140,000. This is subject to also being no more than the lower of 10 times your monthly basic salary and 25 per cent of the purchase price. You must meet all other eligibility criteria including at least 3 years' continuous service, a confirmed contract, no recent written warning, and the flat being your main home in Qatar (completed or at least 50% construction certified complete). Only one housing loan is allowed per employee (or per household if your spouse also works for Meridian). The loan is interest-free and repaid by equal monthly payroll deductions (maximum 15% of your monthly gross salary, or any lower limit set by Qatari labour law) over up to 60 months. Early repayment is allowed without charge in amounts of at least QAR 12,000. If the flat is sold or stops being your main home the balance must be repaid within 30 days. Loans are approved within the fixed annual budget for Qatar (QAR 2,100,000) in the order applications are received, with any excess placed on a waiting list for the next year.

I'm on the Doha payroll and my family lives in Bahrain. How many days a year am I allowed to work remotely from there?

25 working days. Bahrain is an eligible GCC host country. The allowance for employees paid in Qatar is 25 working days per calendar year, with no single stay longer than 14 calendar days and a minimum 30-calendar-day gap between stays. The allowance is counted in home-country working days, resets on 01 January, and unused days lapse on 31 December.

I'm on the Doha payroll and my family lives in Bahrain. How many days a year am I allowed to work remotely from there?
25 working days per calendar year. No single stay may be longer than 14 calendar days, with a minimum gap of 30 calendar days between two stays. The allowance is counted in home-country working days, resets on 01 January, and unused days lapse on 31 December. A partial working day counts as a full day. Weekends and public holidays do not use up the annual allowance but count towards the longest single stay. These limits are in addition to the separate tax and permanent establishment rules (no more than 60 calendar days total in any host country in a rolling 12-month period, counting remote work, annual leave and business travel together).

My basic salary at the Doha branch is QAR 10,000 a month and I'm leaving after six and a half years. For Doha (Qatar), gratuity is 21 days of basic salary per year for years 1 to 5 and 28 days per year after year 5. This gives 5 x 21 = 105 days for the first 5 years and 1.5 x 28 = 42 days for the next 1.5 years, for a total of 147 days. The daily wage is the monthly basic salary divided by 30, so the gratuity is 147 x 10,000 / 30 = QAR 49,000. It is paid in full on resignation or termination once 1 year of service is complete. Other allowances are not part of the gratuity wage.

Bereavement leave for the death of a parent is 5 working days. It must be taken in one continuous block beginning on or within 7 days of the date of death. It may be extended by Earned Leave with the manager's approval. No documentation is required at the time of application; HR Operations may request a death certificate only where the record is being used to update insurance nominations. An employee who must travel for the last rites and is unable to return within the entitlement may apply for up to 5 additional days of Earned Leave, which the manager is expected to approve unless there is an exceptional business reason not to.

راتبك الأساسي ١٠٬٠٠٠ ريال قطري شهرياً، وبعد ٦ سنوات ونصف (٦٫٥ سنوات) في فرع الدوحة، تُحتسب المكافأة كالتالي: للسنوات من ١ إلى ٥: ٥ × ٢١ = ١٠٥ أيام، وللسنة والنصف التالية: ١٫٥ × ٢٨ = ٤٢ يوماً، فيكون المجموع ١٤٧ يوماً. ثم ١٤٧ × ١٠٬٠٠٠ ÷ ٣٠ = ٤٩٬٠٠٠ ريال قطري تقريباً.

راتبك الأساسي 10000 ريال قطري شهرياً، ومدة الخدمة 6.5 سنوات. 
المكافأة تحسب كالتالي: 
- السنتين الأولى والثانية: 7 أيام × 2 = 14 يوماً. 
- السنوات من 3 إلى 6: 14 يوماً × 4 = 56 يوماً. 
- نصف السنة (0.5): 7 أيام. 
المجموع: 77 يوماً. 
الأجر اليومي = 10000 / 30 ≈ 333.33 ريال. 
المكافأة التقريبية = 77 × 333.33 ≈ 25667 ريال قطري. 
(لا تتجاوز 6 أشهر من الراتب الأساسي، وهذا المبلغ ضمن الحد).
